arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Psyche at the Tree of Whispers.

Automatically link your life force with up to {c_number}{SF_3}{/c} nearby enemies. {c_random}[{SF_4}*100|1%|]{/c} of the damage you take is shared with the linked targets as physical damage.{if:SF_2} In addition, for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds after using a {c_important}Defensive{/c}, {c_important}Macabre{/c} or {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skill, any linked damage will be a guaranteed Critical Strike.{/if} Cannot Life Link to enemy Players.
For {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds after using a {c_important}Defensive{/c}, {c_important}Macabre{/c} or {c_important}Subterfuge{/c} Skill, any linked damage will be a guaranteed Critical Strike.
